approved_decisions.E1: Run strict JSON Schema validation before any cross-field checks.
approved_decisions.E2: Require handoff wrappers, hashes, candidate IDs, system references and audit correlation IDs to match their authoritative embedded values.
approved_decisions.E3: Require unique identifiers across all repeatable canonical collections.
approved_decisions.E4: Require all cross-record evidence and entity references to resolve.
approved_decisions.E5: Enforce field baseline, observation, proposal, review and application consistency.
approved_decisions.E6: Validate the separate Field Catalogue only when it is supplied.
approved_decisions.E8: Validate requalification linkage while preserving A1-only numeric scoring.
approved_decisions.E9: Require explicit human approval and write authority before application.
approved_decisions.E10: Validate state transitions, revision lineage and append-only history.
approved_decisions.E11: Enforce synthetic/real separation and no-integration ceilings.
approved_decisions.E12: Reconcile available audit usage and never repair or execute an invalid record.
approved_decisions.E13: Approve corrective schema 1.0.0-draft.2 and Step 2C lifecycle clarification 0.1.1.
